author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (entities)

prerequisites: Four fictional Entities per role created as fixtures; a small fictional text certificate at docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/entities/fixtures/doc029-entities-certificate.txt.
scenarios.expected: The entered corporate facts and files persist with their supported dates and relationships. Invalid ownership/date values and archived/read-only restrictions are handled without changing unrelated facts.
scenarios.actual: Nadia Haddad used Directors & Officers: Add director or officer saved name, Role Director, Appointed on 2022-05-09 and Linked user Daniel Okafor, all present after a reload; a name edit saved on focus change and Role Secretary on selection. Resigned on 2021-01-01 showed "The resignation date cannot be before the appointment date." and stored nothing. Resigned on 2024-08-31 removed the Officer from the current list, Show former showed it, and clearing the date returned it. The linked user held no Grant. "Remove <name>" deleted the Officer (absent with Show former). Add registration saved Jurisdiction, Registration number, Registered agent and Status Lapsed, and Formation jurisdiction stayed "Republic of Aldoria"; an agent edit saved on blur and Withdrawn on selection. "Remove <jurisdiction> registration" deleted the row and left its linked Obligation on the Entity with Registration "None". On Ownership, Add Holding with This Entity owns at 60% listed the Holding under Owned Entities and under Owners on the other record. A second owner through Owns this Entity at 60% showed "Ownership totals 120% for <name>." and saved; correcting it to 40 on blur cleared the warning. 150 in a row was refused with "One or more request fields are invalid." and both saved percentages stayed. The Holding picker did not offer the Entity itself or an Entity already in a Holding with it; a Holding that would close a loop was refused with a message naming the loop path. "Remove <name>" removed a Holding and both Entities still opened. The Documents tab showed "No documents on this Entity yet." with no folders; Upload, Choose files, Kind Executed and Upload gave a v1 row that a sibling Entity did not list. Archive showed the Archived mark and "This entity is archived. Restore it to edit.", disabled Legal name and removed the add controls; the Entity left List search and the Add Holding picker. List with Show archived found it, Restore returned editing, and its formation jurisdiction, Holding, Document and Obligation remained.
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 18 recorded steps for this role, all pass

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-entities is shared with other DOC-029 walkthrough agents. This run created only records named "DOC-029 entities ..." (run tag 9U3SZ) plus records from earlier development runs of the same script with other tags. It changed no organization settings.

Recorded against app source 3fa407e3a846559914aa1a63249741f30cfb4f69, which differs from edition.json's supportedAppCommit; the edition pin or a compatibility review is outside this walkthrough's file ownership.
API calls prepared fixtures (Entities, Holdings, Contracts, a Registration) or read back results the browser had already shown; every documented action was performed through the browser controls.

1 page load(s) showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen because Chromium reported net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED while other labs changed the host's Docker networks. The script recorded each case in the log's errorScreens and reloaded once; the step then passed. This is an environment effect, not an app finding.
The out-of-range Holding percentage refusal shows the generic "One or more request fields are invalid." message; the article does not quote a message.

Not exercised: adding an Officer role (Administrator settings), a concurrent archive/restore by another person, and Document Versions beyond v1, which the article delegates to the shared Document guides.
